metadata.description: A local Windows Outlook (Classic) mailbox for Claude: as Claude Code skills (outlook) or as an MCP server (outlook-mcp). Read search, threads, calendar, follow-ups, meeting prep, .msg/.eml files; the skills plugin also sends or replies, only after the user confirms in a desktop window; the MCP server stays read-only.

plugins.name: outlook
plugins.description: Outlook (Classic) skills: guided setup, search (with attachments and fuzzy reranking), thread summaries, agenda and free slots, morning brief with follow-ups, meeting prep, .msg/.eml parsing, a local memory with settings and a reply-habit profile, and send / reply that goes out only after the user approves the draft in chat and clicks Send in a desktop window. Pick this or outlook-mcp.

plugins.name: outlook-mcp
plugins.description: Read-only MCP server over the same Outlook (Classic) scripts: search mail (with optional reranking), threads, calendar, replies owed and awaited, meeting prep, attachments, mailbox overview, .msg/.eml parsing. For hosts that want tools instead of skills, including the Claude Desktop Chat tab. Pick this or outlook.
